checklist.title: Before this device can be used

problem.xcode-missing: Install Xcode from the App Store to use iOS simulators and iPhones.
problem.apple-silicon-required: Simulator video needs a Mac with Apple silicon; agents can still use the simulator.
problem.android-sdk-missing: Install the Android SDK (Android Studio, or its command-line tools) for emulators and Android phones.
problem.developer-mode-off: Turn on Developer Mode on the device: Settings › Privacy & Security › Developer Mode.
problem.not-paired: Unlock the device and tap Trust on the prompt about this computer.
problem.ddi-not-mounted: Kettu mounts the developer disk image when the device is unlocked; keep it unlocked.
problem.usb-required: Connect the device with a USB cable to see and control its screen.
problem.ios-27-for-input: Touch input from here needs iOS 27; before that, only agents can operate the device.
problem.runner-unsigned: Sign in to Xcode with your Apple ID so Kettu can sign the automation app.
problem.runner-untrusted: On the device, trust the developer in Settings › General › VPN & Device Management.
problem.ui-automation-off: On the device, turn on Settings › Developer › Enable UI Automation.
problem.usb-debugging-unauthorized: Unlock the phone and allow USB debugging for this computer.
problem.offline: The phone is offline. Reconnect its cable.
